outcome: Rates of severe and non-severe PPH
Rates of PPH requiring blood transfusions
cohort: Delivery-related hospitalizations from the 2001-2012 Nationwide Inpatient Sample of the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project
finding: Population-based surveillance data from 2001-2012 showed an increasing rate of severe PPH in the US, while rates of non-severe PPH did not change significantly.
mod_finding: Rates of PPH requiring blood transfusions for caesarean deliveries more than doubled in this time period.
